title: 3EN Agent Runner self-audit before v3.5
description: Read-only self-audit of the active 3EN Agent Runner. Collect evidence about the active runner, process invocation, configuration, polling, task state, result upload logic, backup/rollback handling, logging, error handling and local directory layout. Produce a structured report for designing v3.5. No active runner files are modified.
backup: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $stamp=Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; $BackupRoot=Join-Path 'C:\3EN-Agent\backups\017' $stamp; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $BackupRoot | Out-Null; Set-Content -LiteralPath 'C:\3EN-Agent\backup-017-current.txt' -Value $BackupRoot -Encoding UTF8; $paths=@('C:\3EN-Agent\3en-agent-runner-v3.4.ps1','C:\3EN-Agent\task.json','C:\3EN-Agent\last-task-id.txt'); foreach($p in $paths){if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $p){Copy-Item -LiteralPath $p -Destination $BackupRoot -Force}}; Write-Host ('BACKUP_ROOT='+$BackupRoot); Write-Host 'BACKUP_017_READY'
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $root='C:\3EN-Agent'; $report=Join-Path $root 'self-audit-017.txt'; $runner=Join-Path $root '3en-agent-runner-v3.4.ps1'; $out=New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]; function A([string]$s){$out.Add($s); Write-Host $s}; A '=== 3EN AGENT RUNNER SELF-AUDIT 017 ==='; A ('TIMESTAMP='+([DateTime]::Now.ToString('o'))); A ('COMPUTER='+$env:COMPUTERNAME); A ('USER='+$env:USERNAME); A ('POWERSHELL='+$PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString()); A ''; A '=== ACTIVE RUNNER FILE ==='; if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $runner){$f=Get-Item -LiteralPath $runner; A ('RUNNER_PATH='+$f.FullName); A ('RUNNER_SIZE='+$f.Length); A ('RUNNER_LASTWRITE='+$f.LastWriteTime.ToString('o')); A ('RUNNER_SHA256='+(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $runner -Algorithm SHA256).Hash)}else{A 'RUNNER_MISSING=TRUE'}; A ''; A '=== RUNNING PROCESS EVIDENCE ==='; $procs=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {$_.Name -match 'powershell|pwsh' -and $_.CommandLine -match '3en-agent-runner'} | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name,ExecutablePath,CommandLine); if($procs.Count -eq 0){A 'RUNNER_PROCESS_FOUND=FALSE'}else{A ('RUNNER_PROCESS_COUNT='+$procs.Count); foreach($p in $procs){A ('PID='+$p.ProcessId+' PPID='+$p.ParentProcessId+' EXE='+$p.ExecutablePath); A ('CMD='+$p.CommandLine)}}; A ''; A '=== DIRECTORY LAYOUT ==='; foreach($name in @('runs','results','backups')){$p=Join-Path $root $name; if(Test-Path $p){$items=@(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $p -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); A ($name.ToUpper()+'_EXISTS=TRUE COUNT='+$items.Count)}else{A ($name.ToUpper()+'_EXISTS=FALSE')}}; A ''; A '=== STATE FILES ==='; foreach($name in @('last-task-id.txt','backup-017-current.txt')){$p=Join-Path $root $name; if(Test-Path $p){$val=(Get-Content -LiteralPath $p -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Trim(); A ($name+'='+$val)}else{A ($name+'=MISSING')}}; A ''; A '=== ENVIRONMENT / AUTH PRESENCE ==='; A ('THREEEN_GH_TOKEN_PRESENT='+[bool](-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($env:THREEEN_GH_TOKEN))); A ('THREEEN_GH_TOKEN_LENGTH='+$(if($env:THREEEN_GH_TOKEN){$env:THREEEN_GH_TOKEN.Length}else{0})); A ''; A '=== RUNNER STATIC ANALYSIS ==='; if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $runner){$lines=@(Get-Content -LiteralPath $runner); A ('RUNNER_LINES='+$lines.Count); $checks=[ordered]@{'GitHubContents'='api.github.com|GitHubContents';'RawFallback'='raw.githubusercontent.com';'Polling'='Start-Sleep|Polling|poll';'Approval'='Approve task|Press Y or N|ReadKey';'Backup'='BACKUP|backup';'Rollback'='ROLLBACK|rollback';'ResultUpload'='results/|upload|PUT';'Transcript'='output.txt|Transcript';'LastTask'='last-task-id|LastTask';'Base64'='Base64|ToBase64String';'ErrorHandling'='try\s*\{|catch\s*\{|ErrorActionPreference'}; foreach($k in $checks.Keys){$hits=@($lines | Select-String -Pattern $checks[$k] -AllMatches); A ('FEATURE_'+$k.ToUpper()+'_HITS='+$hits.Count)}; A ''; A '=== IMPORTANT RUNNER LINES ==='; $patterns=@('TaskUrl','Poll','Start-Sleep','last-task','Approve task','Run rollback','GitHubContents','api.github.com','raw.githubusercontent.com','results/','output.txt','Base64','Invoke-RestMethod','Invoke-WebRequest','ConvertTo-Json','ReadKey','try','catch'); foreach($pat in $patterns){$hits=@(Select-String -LiteralPath $runner -Pattern $pat -SimpleMatch -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 12); foreach($h in $hits){A (('{0,4}: {1}' -f $h.LineNumber,$h.Line.Trim()))}}}; A ''; A '=== RECENT RUNS ==='; $runs=Join-Path $root 'runs'; if(Test-Path $runs){$recent=@(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $runs -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 10); foreach($r in $recent){A ($r.Name+' | '+$r.LastWriteTime.ToString('o'))}}; A ''; A '=== AUDIT FLAGS ==='; if(-not(Test-Path -LiteralPath $runner)){A 'FLAG_CRITICAL_ACTIVE_RUNNER_FILE_NOT_FOUND'}; if($procs.Count -gt 1){A 'FLAG_MULTIPLE_RUNNER_PROCESSES'}; if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($env:THREEEN_GH_TOKEN)){A 'FLAG_TOKEN_NOT_VISIBLE_IN_RUNNER_ENV'}; A 'SELF_AUDIT_017=PASS'; $out | Set-Content -LiteralPath $report -Encoding UTF8; Write-Host ('REPORT='+$report)
test: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $report='C:\3EN-Agent\self-audit-017.txt'; if(-not(Test-Path -LiteralPath $report)){throw 'Self-audit report missing'}; $c=Get-Content -LiteralPath $report -Raw; foreach($m in @('3EN AGENT RUNNER SELF-AUDIT 017','ACTIVE RUNNER FILE','RUNNING PROCESS EVIDENCE','RUNNER STATIC ANALYSIS','SELF_AUDIT_017=PASS')){if($c -notmatch [regex]::Escape($m)){throw ('Missing marker: '+$m)}}; Write-Host ('REPORT_SIZE='+(Get-Item -LiteralPath $report).Length); Write-Host 'VALIDATION_017=PASS'
rollback: Write-Host 'READ-ONLY SELF-AUDIT: active runner was not modified; no rollback required.'
